resolution.title: [Mellanox] Fix qos sai issues on dualtor setup
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Fix issue: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/10526
1. When calling QosParamMellanox(), the argument dst_dut_index, dst_asic_index oder is not correct. we should exchange them.
2. The Fanout device doesn't match the duthost
3. When topo is not defined in qos_param['mellanox'], we should use the default one

Summary:

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/10526. ,make QoS sai test running on dualtor setup with Mellanox device

#### How did you do it?
1.  Exchange dst_dut_index, dst_asic_index oder in QosParamMellanox
2. Use duthost to get the peer device_info
3. When topo is not defined in qos_param['mellanox'], we should use the default one

#### How did you verify/test it?
Run qos sai tests on dualtor setup with Mellanox device
